data.one_liner: Generates a dummy test file importing all Dart files to ensure accurate code coverage reports.
data.what_it_does: It finds all Dart files in specified directories like lib and creates a dummy test file that imports them all. This ensures that coverage tools register all files, even those not explicitly imported by other tests.
use_when: You want accurate code coverage reports that include untested files.
You use coverage tools that only track files triggered by actual test imports.
avoid_when: You manually manage comprehensive test imports for coverage.
You do not use code coverage tools in your project.
strengths: Automates the creation of a comprehensive coverage test file.
Supports ignoring specific files using patterns.
weaknesses: Relies on shell execution and global activation.
Not documented beyond basic script execution.
data.setup_notes: Activated globally via pub and run as a command-line script.
